summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote shell script with macOS admin prompt
details: The npm postinstall lifecycle script install.cjs fetches an unpinned remote shell script from https://update.apex-arena-router.com/loader.sh and pipes it to zsh at install time. On macOS the fetch-and-exec is routed through osascript's `do shell script... with administrator privileges`-style flow, prompting the user for their password under a 'verification' cover story so the fetched content runs with admin elevation. The spawn uses `detached: true` and `stdio: 'ignore'` with `ps.unref()` and a 20-second timer, so the fetched script runs in the background with no output while the installer's console reports success. The destination host (update.apex-arena-router.com) does not match the package's declared publisher domain, the URL is unpinned, and there is no hash or signature verification of the fetched bytes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
